sources: https://www.dakotacityiowa.com/general/page/dakota-city-campground (HTTP 403 to plain HTTP, as is the city's home page; not retried by another route - UNREAD), 2026-11-03
RV Life 'Dakota City Memorial Park & Campground' (id 11292: 3.5 stars, price level 1, avg $12; directory lists 8 sites at 809 1st Ave N) - directory only, not used for any field, read 2026-11-03

Esri World Imagery at 42.7235,-94.1940 (600 m frame) and 42.72367,-94.19365 (220 m frame): the campground is a small gravel loop with angled grass pads plus a row of RVs along its west side, just north of the 1st Ave bridge on the west bank of the river; the river here is ~35-45 m wide; the nearest pads on the loop's east side are ~45 m from the bank with the loop road and a band of trees between; a gravel track runs down to the water at the south-east corner, read 2026-11-03 (Overpass unavailable; widths are imagery estimates)
note: City of Dakota City park on the west bank of the Des Moines River just north of the 1st Avenue bridge: a small gravel camp loop set back from the river behind the loop road and a band of trees, with a tent area. --Claude
summary: City website refused plain HTTP (403) - nothing verified from the operator; no rate found on any official page. No groups changed. Waterfront lead riverfront -> not waterfront (imagery: loop road and trees between pads and river; no photos). Note corrected ('on the riverbank' was wrong).
flags: UNREAD: https://www.dakotacityiowa.com/general/page/dakota-city-campground and the city home page both answer HTTP 403 to plain HTTP; not retried by another route. Rate, site count (stored 14; RV Life says 8), hookups and showers remain unverified, and no fees were written. The stored values were left alone because I could not show they rest only on a directory.

WATERFRONT LEAD (riverfront -> not waterfront): the river is river-class (~35-45 m wide at the site, over the ~30 m line), but imagery shows the nearest pads ~45 m from the bank with the campground's own loop road and a band of trees between - on-water is ruled out by the loop road (AWH 2026-11-01). No official campsite photos could be read, so a filtered river view is unconfirmed and the unsure rule takes it to not waterfront; an official photo of the river from a site would support riverview.
RATE: none on any page I could read; RV Life gives $ (avg $12), which is a directory tier only. City-run, so the private price gate does not apply.
PIN: stored 42.72350,-94.19400 is at the south end of the camp loop; fine. Phone 515-332-4350 could not be checked against the city page.
